title: Inverted index basics
text: An inverted index maps each term to a list of documents that contain the term. It is the classic structure behind keyword search and information retrieval systems.

title: TF-IDF weighting
text: TF-IDF combines term frequency with inverse document frequency to score how important a word is to a document in a corpus. Common words get lower IDF weights.

title: BM25 ranking
text: BM25 is a probabilistic ranking function used by many search engines. It improves on TF-IDF with length normalization and term frequency saturation.

title: Vector embeddings
text: Dense vector embeddings map text into a continuous semantic space. Similar meanings end up closer together even when different words are used.

title: FAISS approximate search
text: FAISS is a library for efficient similarity search and clustering of dense vectors. It supports exact flat indexes and faster approximate nearest neighbor graphs.

title: Hybrid retrieval
text: Hybrid search combines lexical matching with semantic vectors. Reciprocal rank fusion is a simple way to merge two ranked lists without tuning score scales.

title: FastAPI for APIs
text: FastAPI is a modern Python web framework for building APIs with automatic validation and OpenAPI documentation. It works well with async endpoints.

title: React user interfaces
text: React is a JavaScript library for building user interfaces from components. It pairs well with Vite for fast local development and production builds.

title: PostgreSQL storage
text: PostgreSQL is a relational database used for durable metadata, users, and transactional workloads. Vector extensions can also store embeddings at scale.

title: Redis caching
text: Redis is an in-memory data store often used for caching, rate limiting, pub sub messaging, and short lived session state in web applications.

title: GPU matrix multiply
text: NVIDIA GPUs accelerate large matrix multiplies used in deep learning training and inference. Throughput depends on batch size precision and memory bandwidth.

title: Apple Neural Engine
text: Apple Silicon includes a Neural Engine optimized for on device machine learning. Core ML converts models for efficient mobile and laptop inference.

title: Operating system kernels
text: A kernel manages memory processes scheduling and hardware traps. User programs invoke the kernel through system calls with controlled privilege transitions.

title: Computer vision pipelines
text: Vision pipelines decode frames run detectors and trackers then render overlays. Async workers keep heavy inference off the HTTP request path.

title: Multi object tracking
text: Tracking assigns consistent identities to objects across video frames. ByteTrack is a popular association algorithm paired with detection boxes per frame.

title: Semantic search limitations
text: Semantic search can miss rare exact identifiers like error codes or SKUs. Lexical search still matters for precise tokens and named entities.

title: Evaluation metrics
text: Information retrieval quality is measured with precision recall nDCG and MRR on labeled query sets. Offline metrics guide ranking improvements.

title: Tokenization choices
text: Tokenization splits text into units for indexing. Choices include whitespace splitting subword models and language specific normalization rules.

title: Snippet generation
text: Snippets summarize why a document matched a query. Query biased snippets select windows that contain many query terms for better readability.

title: Responsible crawling
text: Search engines respect robots dot txt and terms of service. Research prototypes should use licensed corpora or data you own instead of scraping blindly.
